## Problem

What does this contribution correct, test, clarify, or add?

## Evidence

What source, observation, or argument supports the change? State its limits.

## Change

What changed, and why is this the smallest sufficient revision?

## Review checklist

- [ ] I separated observation from inference and human decisions from agent behavior.
- [ ] I did not add credentials, personal data, or non-public employer, client, or third-party information.
- [ ] I checked links and any adjacent claims made inaccurate by this change.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this material under the destination path's license.
- [ ] I disclosed AI tools when that information is material to reproducing the contribution.

## Known limits

What remains unresolved or should not be concluded from this change?
